about.title: About Iranian Marketplace
about.missionBody: Iranian Marketplace connects Iranian supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, cafes, and caterers in Dubai with the Iranian community — in one place, in your own language.
about.storyBody: Today, finding Iranian products in Dubai usually means word of mouth, scrolling Instagram pages, or driving between shops hoping one of them has what you need. We built Iranian Marketplace so the whole Iranian food community in Dubai is searchable from one app — in English, Farsi, or Arabic.
about.howBody: We don't own inventory or set prices. Each business manages its own store profile, menu, and pricing, and receives orders directly. We simply bring customers and businesses together and handle the technology in between.
about.visionBody: We're starting with groceries and restaurants, and growing into bakeries, cafes, and catering — with the goal of becoming the everyday online home for Iranian life in Dubai.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: A marketplace that brings together Iranian supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, cafes, and caterers across Dubai, so you can browse and order from all of them in one place.
faq.a2: Each business delivers its own orders, the same way they always have — we just handle discovery, ordering, and payment.
faq.a3: You can pay online by card at checkout, or choose cash/card on delivery — whichever you prefer.
faq.q4: Can I order from multiple businesses in one order?
faq.a4: Not yet — each order is placed with a single vendor, since that vendor handles its own delivery.
faq.q5: How do I list my business on Iranian Marketplace?
faq.a5: Sign up as a vendor from the signup page, add your store details, and submit for approval. Once approved, you can add your products or menu and start receiving orders.
faq.q6: Is there a fee for customers?
faq.a6: Browsing and ordering is free for customers. Businesses pay a small commission on completed orders.
faq.q7: What if I have an issue with my order?
faq.a7: Reach out to the vendor directly for order-specific issues — their contact details are on their store page. For anything else, contact us through the details on this page.

legal.disclaimer: This is a general template for a starting business and has not been reviewed by a lawyer. Have it reviewed against UAE consumer protection and data protection (PDPL) requirements before relying on it for a real launch.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By creating an account or placing an order on Iranian Marketplace, you agree to these Terms of Service.
terms.s2Body: Iranian Marketplace is a technology platform that connects independent Iranian supermarkets, restaurants, bakeries, cafes, and caterers ("vendors") with customers. We do not own, stock, or prepare any products ourselves — each vendor is solely responsible for its own inventory, pricing, menu, food safety, and delivery.
terms.s3Body: You must provide accurate information when creating a customer or vendor account and are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure.
terms.s4Body: Vendors must hold all licenses and permits required to sell their products in Dubai/UAE, accurately describe and price their products, and fulfill and deliver orders they accept.
terms.s5Body: Placing an order creates a contract directly between you and the vendor. We facilitate payment (online via card, or cash/card on delivery) and charge vendors a commission on completed orders; we are not a party to the sale itself.
terms.s6Body: Cancellation and refund requests should first be directed to the vendor, since they control fulfillment. Contact us if a vendor is unresponsive.
terms.s7Body: You may not use the platform for unlawful purposes, to list counterfeit or unsafe goods, or to interfere with other users' use of the service.
terms.s8Body: To the extent permitted by law, Iranian Marketplace is not liable for the quality, safety, or legality of vendor products, or for delivery delays caused by a vendor.
terms.s9Body: We may update these terms from time to time; continued use of the platform after a change means you accept the updated terms.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates.
terms.s11Body: Questions about these terms can be sent through the contact details on our About page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Account details (name, email, phone), delivery addresses, order history, and — for vendors — store and product information. We do not store your full card number; payments are processed by Stripe.
privacy.s2Body: To operate your account, process and deliver orders, communicate order updates, and improve the platform.
privacy.s3Body: When you place an order, we share the information needed to fulfill it (name, delivery address, order items) with the relevant vendor.
privacy.s4Body: Online payments are handled by Stripe, our payment processor. Stripe's own privacy policy governs how they handle your payment details.
privacy.s5Body: We keep account and order data for as long as your account is active, or as required for legal and accounting purposes.
privacy.s6Body: You can request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data by contacting us.
privacy.s7Body: We use essential cookies to keep you logged in and remember your language and cart.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this policy from time to time and will post the updated version here.
privacy.s9Body: Questions about this policy can be sent through the contact details on our About page.

vendorAgreement.title: Vendor Agreement
vendorAgreement.s1Body: You must be a legally registered business in the UAE holding all trade licenses and food/health permits required for the products you sell.
vendorAgreement.s2Body: New vendor listings are reviewed by our team before going live. We may suspend or remove a listing that violates these terms or applicable law.
vendorAgreement.s3Body: You control your own prices, product/menu content, and availability, and are responsible for keeping them accurate and up to date.
vendorAgreement.s4Body: We charge a commission (shown in your vendor dashboard) on each completed order. Online payments are settled to your connected payout account; cash/card-on-delivery orders are collected by you directly.
vendorAgreement.s5Body: You are responsible for confirming, preparing, and delivering orders you accept within a reasonable time.
vendorAgreement.s6Body: You are solely responsible for food safety, hygiene, and the accuracy of any claims (e.g. halal, allergen information) about your products.
vendorAgreement.s7Body: You operate as an independent business, not as an employee or agent of Iranian Marketplace.
vendorAgreement.s8Body: We may suspend or terminate your vendor account for repeated customer complaints, licensing issues, or violation of this agreement.
vendorAgreement.s9Body: Questions about this agreement can be sent through the contact details on our About page.
